verdict.rationale: Teller documents outbound webhooks that fire when conditions change in enrollments or financial data. These are a developer building block for constructing automation, not a product capability that lets users define rules that automatically trigger actions. No rules engine or event-to-action configuration is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Teller sends webhook events when specific conditions or changes are detected in user enrollments or their financial data.
To register a new webhook, you need to have a URL in your app that Teller can call.
